questions.content: There are 4 men and 5 women in Group A, and 5 men and 4 women in Group B. If 4 persons are selected from each group, then the number of ways of selecting 4 men and 4 women is ________.

en.content: There are 4 men and 5 women in Group A, and 5 men and 4 women in Group B. If 4 persons are selected from each group, then the number of ways of selecting 4 men and 4 women is ________.
en.explanation: Group A Group B Ways

hi.content: समूह में 4 आदमी तथा 5 औरतें हैं, और समूह में 5 आदमी तथा 4 औरतें हैं। यदि 4 व्यक्तियों को प्रत्येक समूह से चुना जाता है, तो 4 आदमी तथा 4 औरतों के चुने जाने वाले तरीकों की संख्या है ________.
hi.explanation: समूह A समूह B तरीके

questions.subject: mathematics
questions.explanation: Group A Group B Ways
